name: HRTS 5327
title: Propaganda, Disinformation, and Hate Speech
description: (Also offered as ANTH 5327.) Draws on current social science research and legal scholarship to understand the effects of disinformation and hate speech on individual moral decision-making, as well as on wider politics and culture. Evaluates various private and public initiatives to regulate speech.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
